code:
JUDGE_PROMPT = """You are evaluating two AI assistant responses
to the same user question. Judge which response better addresses
the question: more helpful, more accurate, appropriately concise.
Avoid favoring length alone. If truly equal, say "tie."

[User Question]
{question}

[Response A]
{response_a}

[Response B]
{response_b}

Which response is better: A, B, or tie? Explain briefly, then
give your final verdict."""
caption: The anti-length instruction and reasoning-before-verdict are deliberate bias mitigations.
